how_to_find: Open the repo on GitHub. Read the version field in .claude-plugin/plugin.json. Also read the date of the newest commit on the main branch. The repo has no release tags that this wizard could confirm (VERIFY on the GitHub releases page).

versions.title: Hook, Pi config and docs updates after 0.2.0
versions.summary: Newest commit seen when this wizard was built: cbe69fb (2026-08-26) in keyona-rerev/i-have-adhd. The plugin.json version still reads 0.2.0. VERIFY: dates and changes come from commit messages, not from a release note.

A Pi config file with alwaysOn and hideStatus options (commit 04376f8, 2026-08-20).
The alwaysOn option is declared for Pi (commit cf47132, 2026-08-26).
Docs: contributing guide, agent repository guide and pull request template (2026-08-18).
